## Method submission

- [ ] `submissions/<name>.py` with a class subclassing `Estimator` or `Detector`, unique lowercase `name`
- [ ] `results/submissions/<name>/` produced by `scripts/evaluate_submission.py` (with `meta.json`)
- [ ] The method uses only the scores and the `History` it receives
- [ ] Experiments skipped for missing data (if any) are listed in `meta.json`; maintainers will run them
